item.text: {"case_id":"SHC013","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C02","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 is a clear, concrete drafting template for the substance of the later congressional letter. The child adapts C06's national-emergency findings and transaction-control machinery from information and communications technology and services to bulk-power system electric equipment. It preserves distinctive language about foreign-adversary ownership or control, balancing an open investment climate against national-security needs, the same three-part risk test, and authority to direct cessation of transactions, adopt regulations, and employ IEEPA powers. C02 and C21 are the strongest secondary candidates because they share the Trump-era congressional-report structure and similar delegation and agency-implementation language, but those features are
